name: Mejiro
tagline: Shinjuku in 9 minutes and Shibuya in 17 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Toshima City, served by JR Yamanote Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 22 minutes to Otemachi, 9 minutes to Shinjuku, 17 minutes to Shibuya and 40 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 24.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 24.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 14.9 m to 33.2 m, a difference of 18.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 0.5 to 3 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.

groceries.name: クイーンズ伊勢丹 目白店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 14 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 悦伝会目白病院, about 12 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 大同病院, about 13 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: JR Yamanote Line.
congestion: JR Yamanote Line runs at 136% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. 1LDK ¥170,000 to ¥180,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Gakushuinshita is ahead on how easy the shopping is, but Mejiro is ahead on how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Mejiro. It takes 10 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Mejiro. One-room rents run about ¥8,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Zoshigaya is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Mejiro is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Mejiro. It takes 4 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Mejiro.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 8 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the JR Yamanote Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
